resources.string: Optional. Log a reading from your meter if you track glucose.
Ketone readings stay on this device. Health Connect has no ketone type, so they are not shared.
Readings vary from person to person and meter to meter. Any ranges shown here are general information, not advice. Your clinician can tell you what is right for you.

A reading under 70 mg/dL (3.9 mmol/L) is generally considered low. It is a good moment to break your fast with something that contains sugar and to follow your clinician\'s plan. If you feel shaky, confused or unwell, get medical help.
Ketones of 3.0 mmol/L or more are higher than usual for fasting. If you have diabetes, or you feel sick, thirsty or short of breath, stop fasting and contact your clinician.
Glucose readings are also saved to Health Connect.
Save glucose readings to Health Connect too?
Correlation, not cause: sleep, heart rate and glucose change for many reasons. Comparisons appear only once there is enough data on both sides. General information, not advice.
